answer: The garden index is deterministic from ledger replay, and as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 338 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the atlas. Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the prism queue while honest participants promoted earlier keep earning. The deposit is 43 dollars a seat. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
